item.title: Example Audio launches a cardioid subwoofer for touring line arrays
item.description:
Example Audio has introduced a new cardioid subwoofer designed to sit under its line array systems, reducing low-frequency energy on stage and behind the PA. The company says the cabinet weighs less than its predecessor and ships with presets for its amplifier platform.

The post Example Audio launches a cardioid subwoofer appeared first on Example Trade Weekly.
